title: Bind the Spell's Name
prompt: Build the opening line that names a spell and names the reagent it takes.

fragments.wrong_hint: return sends a value BACK — it does not begin a spell. To DEFINE one, start with def.
This spell needs a reagent. Name the parameter inside the brackets: (power).

config.success: def firebolt(power): — the spell is named, its reagent declared, ready for its body.
